verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to define windows, tabs, panes, or startup commands in a config file or script and open them with one command. Session restoration only reopens the previous layout automatically on relaunch. The new settings file and Warp Drive workflows are related features, but neither defines a workspace layout, so none of this earns credit for the story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can define startup sessions and window layouts in config or scripts so a project workspace opens in one command
